system.description:
Trigger: You make an FBA attack or use a Combo Skill.

Blitz Strike | Trigger — Light FBA/Combo: Your attack roll gains +3. You deal damage equal to [2 x Soul] and the target rolls Physical Resistance. On failure the target becomes [Staggered].

Drop Kick | Trigger — Heavy FBA/Combo: You deal damage equal to [3 x Soul] and become [Dropped]. The target rolls Physical Resistance. On failure the target becomes Stunned.

Grounded Impact | Trigger — Grab FBA/Combo: You deal damage equal to [Soul]. The target rolls Physical Resistance. On failure you immediately make a Quick Attack and the target rolls another Physical Resistance roll. On failure make another Quick Attack.
